title: Janabe fatema
body:
khadi hai masjid e nabawi mein ho kar
bekas o muztar janabe fatema zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zehra hoon mujhe pehchano
ye kehti hai wo ro ro kar
janabe fatema zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
rasan basta gulu e hyder e safdar
kabhi dekha kabhi dekha hai dar jalta
shikasta phasliyon ko thaam kar
kehti hai ghut ghut kar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bacche chote chote sehm kar
maadar se lipte hai bahot betaab hote hai
wo bacchon ko sambhale ya rakhe
marham wo zakhmon par
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e darbar aayi qadmon pe
chalti hui zahra magar jab de chuki khutba
sahara leke fizza ka gayi
baba ki turbat par
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
masayib mujhpe jo toote dino par
wo agar padte to din raaton mein dhal jaate
mujhe tum paas bulwa lo
yehi kehti hai ro ro kar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta phasliyon ke zakhm mein
wo dard badta tha magar posheeda hi rakha
namazein pad rahi thi rakh ke
daaya haath pehlu par
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
falak bhi keh raha tha ye aziyat
dene waalon se ye kalma padne waalon se
jise jhutla rahe ho tum
wohi hai juzwe paighambar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
shab e rukhsat hai waqt e aakhri hai
dum ukhadta hai ke sab kunba bichadta hai
utha tareeki e shab mein
janaza haye ye keh kar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bibi ki aza ke din mai hoon
qalbe tapan majid ho kaise shadman majid
bas ek nauha ho lab par
haye zahra binte paighambar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
author: Majid Raza Abidi
